title: Full-stack web engineering
body: TypeScript, React, Node.js and PHP. WordPress and WooCommerce in depth, plus modern stacks like Astro and Sanity.

title: DevOps and infrastructure

title: Support and team leadership
body: Five years as a senior escalation engineer at WordPress.com, team management, and building tools that take pressure off the people dealing with customers.
